classification: Configurable emulator capacity policy; researched limits and unknown historical values remain separately recorded in house_variant_capacities.json.
operator_instructions: Edit effective_fields, keep their field_sources accurate, and increment policy_revision. Regenerate fresh content. Existing rooms require a separately reviewed append-only capacity policy; never overwrite their immutable base profile.
counting_policy: Placed ordinary furniture, NPC items and non-estate vault entries share max_items. A placed child crate consumes one parent item slot; crate contents use the child estate budget. Existing property-wide crate restrictions remain authoritative.
child_definition_provenance: Definition174 is an exact existing emulator technical record, not a recovered original Live definition. Other recognized crate IDs175..184 have no approved complete capacity record here.
